# paper_out/

## Purpose

Output directory for publication-ready artifacts generated by the `paper_artifacts/` pipeline. Contains figures, tables, and underlying data for the TEL-PPO research paper.

## Key Contents

| Path | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `figures/` | Publication figures in PNG and PDF formats (300 DPI) |
| `tables/` | LaTeX tables (.tex) and CSV data files |
| `data/` | Underlying data used to generate figures |

## Entry Points / How to Use

**Generated automatically** - do not edit manually:

```bash
# Generate all paper artifacts
python -m paper_artifacts make_all

# Regenerate specific figure
python -m paper_artifacts plot convergence_main --out-dir paper_out/figures
```

## Dependencies & Contracts

**Depends on:**
- `paper_artifacts/` - Generation pipeline
- `results/convergence_history/` - Source data

**Provides to system:**
- Publication-ready figures for papers
- LaTeX-compatible tables
- Reproducible data exports

## Output Structure

```
paper_out/
├── figures/
│   ├── convergence_main.png/pdf
│   ├── kl_dynamics.png/pdf
│   ├── exploitability_dynamics.png/pdf
│   ├── beta_evolution.png/pdf
│   ├── beta_snapshots.png/pdf
│   └── ablation_comparison.png/pdf
├── tables/
│   ├── summary_metrics.csv/tex
│   ├── ablation_results.csv/tex
│   ├── final_summary.csv/tex
│   └── convergence_comparison.csv/tex
└── data/
    ├── convergence_main.csv
    ├── kl_dynamics.csv
    ├── exploitability_dynamics.csv
    └── beta_evolution.csv
```

## Gotchas / Conventions

- **Do not edit directly** - regenerate via `paper_artifacts/` pipeline
- PNG files are 300 DPI for publication quality
- PDF files are vector format for LaTeX inclusion
- Data files in CSV format for reproducibility
- Tables are provided in both CSV (data) and LaTeX (formatted) formats
